title: Utilz's bin/.devbin/cmd/macos duplicates the app half devbin ships as its built-in macos: converge on the built-in once devbin's next release carries every check Utilz's handler makes
body:
## What

utilz-vc, 27 Oct 2026, on hv's yes; filed by utilz-ic, owner ic. It rides the first Utilz release after devbin 0.1.16 is cut and vendored (hv, 27 Oct).

- Utilz's own handler, `bin/.devbin/cmd/macos`, carries an app half: store-creds, doctor's signing lines, app-sign, app-notarize, app-verify and publish. devbin 0.1.15 ships the same half as its built-in `bin/.devbin/lib/cmd/macos` (devbin issue 0226), so one concern has two homes.
- Under 0.1.15 a project handler shadows the built-in of its name totally (`lib/resolve:38-45`, `667-691`), so 2.14.4 was signed by Utilz's handler. vc's probe of `bin/devbin macos` at 06:53Z on 27 Oct showed this.
- The fix converges Menuz's signing path on the built-in and deletes Utilz's handler. app-icons, which is Menuz's own, stays Utilz's as a declared option.

Below, B is the built-in (`bin/.devbin/lib/cmd/macos`), U is Utilz's handler (`bin/.devbin/cmd/macos`), and LS is `opt/menuz/lib/launch-services.sh`. Every line cited was read at 14103179.

## Done when

devbin-vc's words, through vc, 27 Oct: "Utilz can delete bin/.devbin/cmd/macos and lose no check it makes today."

## What devbin carries first

devbin 0243, for devbin 0.1.16, is the devbin half (filed by devbin-vc at 23272153 in devbin's repository). devbin-cc builds it, devbin-vc lands it, and hv cuts. 0243's Done when includes utilz-vc's agreement that Utilz can delete U without losing any check it makes, Utilz 0115's included, once 0243's Resolution maps each of U's checks to B's.

**The app's version.**
- B's `app_ship_blockers` (B:387-396) holds the bundle's `CFBundleShortVersionString` to the project's version: read_version, which is VERSION, 2.14.4 today.
- Menuz's version is opt/menuz/VERSION (0.4.7), so B refuses every Menuz build, at app-sign (B:583) and again at publish (B:689, 707).
- devbin takes `macos.version_from`, defaulting to `project.version_from` and read by the same reader. The tag and the release stay the project's.

**Freshness that does not rest on the version.**
- 0103 holds the staged copy and the published copy to the tag's own build: `MenuzKind` is `release`, and the tag's commit begins with `MenuzCommit` (U:397-422, 438-444, 704-705, 736-738).
- devbin takes a commit stamp the project names in Info.plist, checked against the tag's commit. devbin-vc leans towards refusing when the app's version source differs from the project's and no stamp is declared.
- The commit check refuses when the tag is not in the tree, as U's does.

**The release kind**, if it generalises to a declared Info.plist key and value.

**A product outside the root.**
- `macos.app` is read literally, from the root or absolute (B:153-160). lib/config parses with awk and `cfg_get` returns the cached text (lib/config:225-243, 273-285), so nothing expands `~`, `$HOME` or `$XDG_STATE_HOME`.
- Menuz's product is `${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/menuz/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Menuz.app` (opt/menuz/menuz:121-134).
- A copy under the root is out. menuz keeps its products off the tree, and Launch Services registers bundles left under ~/Devel (0106).

**Checked drops on every path out.**
- B's `ls_forget` (B:262-267) runs `lsregister -u`, discards its words and its exit, and reads nothing back.
- It runs only on the success paths (B:367, 592, 642, 659, 669). So a die after staging, such as codesign's at B:588-589, leaves the stage's record.
- 0104 and 0106 drop through LS on every path out and read the record list afterwards (U:621-689). A record left is a warning. In publish, a record left, a list not read or a staging dir not removed turns exit 0 into 1.
- 0115 ends publish, after its upload, with a drop of every record at or under the build root, `${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/menuz/build/macos`, through LS's `ls_drop_under`, with the list read back (U:744-749). A record left there, or a list not read, is a warning, and the exit stands. 0243's Done when carries it: after publish, no record remains at or under the declared product's build root, read back.

## What B carries already

- **Signing:** the identity search, the keychain prefix (`macos.keychain`), the entitlements, the nested inside-out signing with the hardened runtime, and the signature readback.
- **Notarisation:** notarytool, stapler, and the quarantined copy's spctl check.
- **The gate before the build:** B's `require_tag_head` (B:410-423) wants HEAD at the tag's commit in a clean tree. That is 0103's pre-build check, asked of the whole tree. (`utilz menuz stamps` says `release` only at the tag, from a clean source tree.)
- **The stage:** one per checkout, at `$XDG_STATE_HOME/devbin/macos/<name>-<sha12 of the root>` (B:172-179). U keeps one per machine.
- **publish** goes through `bin/devbin release attach <version> --from` (B:681-714; lib/cmd/release:1403-1438):
  - an asset already there with the same bytes counts as done;
  - one with other bytes is refused, never replaced;
  - SHA256SUMS is written over every asset and read back.

## The Utilz side, once devbin 0.1.16 carries the above and Utilz vendors it

**Config** (bin/.devbin/config.yaml): `commands.macos.enabled: true`, and a `macos:` block with these keys:
- `app`, in the form devbin's issue settles;
- `build: bin/utilz menuz build --release`;
- `bundle_id`;
- `entitlements: native/macos/Menuz/Menuz/Menuz.entitlements`;
- `keychain: utilz.apple`, so hv's stored credentials stay where they are;
- the version source, opt/menuz/VERSION;
- the stamp and kind keys as devbin names them (`MenuzCommit`; `MenuzKind` with `release`).

`asset` takes its default, Menuz.app.zip.

**app-icons.**
- U is deleted, since it shadows B totally. app-icons becomes `commands.macos.options.app-icons.run: <script>` with `in_all: false`, so `macos all` does not sweep it (lib/resolve:879-884).
- The key is valid (lib/config:156, 483-485). A declared option routes before anything else, and every other word reaches B (lib/resolve:888-890, 923-924, 1446-1452).
- The script lives outside cmd/. Every executable there is a command of its own (lib/resolve:713-725).
- Its doctor lines go with it, as a check of its own: rsvg-convert, menuz.svg and menuz-mark.svg, and the asset catalogue (U:125-150). B's doctor covers the signing lines (U:151-184).

**The bundle id.** `macos.bundle_id` is a second copy of the literal beside LS's `MENUZ_BUNDLE_ID`. macos.bats's one-home test becomes a guard that the two are equal.

**app-verify's product checks move into menuz** (vc's call, 27 Oct).
- U's app-verify debug and release (U:586-613) check a build product's executable, `LSUIElement` and stamps.
- U:607 is the only check on a built bundle that `LSUIElement` is true (native/macos/Menuz/Menuz/Info.plist:25), and it runs in every mode, dist included. Dropping it would lose a check, which the Done-when rules out.
- So menuz checks its own product after each build, where the product is made:
  - the executable is there;
  - `LSUIElement` is true;
  - the stamps read back equal to what `menuz stamps` predicted for the build.
- A miss fails the build.
- dist is a ditto copy of a checked product plus a signature, so this check does not wait on devbin generalising a declared key and value.

**LS** keeps one user, menuz, and its header stops naming bin/devbin macos.

**Docs:**
- docs/releasing.md's "After the cut: Menuz.app" (59-89): the steps, the refusals, the stage, publish's attach, and 0106's paragraph;
- help/menuz.md, where it names the release build and the asset (247-288);
- the comment at .github/workflows/tests.yml:516;
- CHANGELOG.

**Tests:** opt/menuz/test/macos.bats keeps what stays Utilz's: the declaration, the id guard, and app-icons with its check and its routing. The signing half is tested in devbin's suite. macos.bats's tests of app-verify's product modes move to menuz.bats with the fakes, as tests of the build's own check. A new or moved test is proven red by a one-line mutation only where reading it cannot show it fails (vc's decision 67, 27 Oct).

## Proof before the cut it rides (vc: a signed, notarised publish is the proof)

1. **The fakes:** macos.bats green, with a mutation only where reading a test cannot show it fails.
2. **A booked real run before the cut**, in launchsvc and heavy, through vc and molt-vc.
   - It runs from a scratch clone at main's tip with the convergence. Its VERSION is set to a scratch version and tagged there, never pushed, so `require_tag_head` passes.
   - It runs app-sign, app-notarize and app-verify through B, and reads the records after each.
   - It reads the bundle id's record list before and after. At the end, only ~/Applications/Menuz.app may be registered for com.matthewsinclair.utilz.menuz.
   - Signing and the notary submission run on hv's word.
   - publish runs only as far as its refusal: with no release object for the scratch version, it uploads nothing.
3. **The cut's own post-cut steps through B are the last proof,** read as 2.14.4's were:
   - `unzip -p` of the asset's Info.plist;
   - its sha256 against GitHub's digest;
   - SHA256SUMS read back;
   - the records after Homebrew's `menuz install`.

## hv's rulings, 27 Oct (through vc; vc's decision 68)

- **The order:** Utilz's next release does not wait for devbin 0.1.16. 0118 rides the first Utilz release after 0.1.16 (devbin 0243) is cut and vendored, which is 2.14.5 only if 0.1.16 lands first. It is deferred on the record with hv's say.
- **SHA256SUMS:** a SHA256SUMS asset on every Utilz release, written by devbin's release attach once 0118 lands: accepted.
- **The smaller changes in what the release steps do,** all accepted:
  - an interrupt exits 1, not 130, 143 or 129;
  - a publish that finds Menuz.app.zip already attached with the same bytes reads as done, where U refuses it;
  - the stage moves to devbin/macos/Utilz-<sha12>;
  - the notary zip is named submission.zip;
  - off macOS the command exits 2.

## Size and placement

Size M on the Utilz side, sized again once 0243's Resolution maps U's checks to B's. It rides the first Utilz release after devbin 0.1.16 is cut and vendored (hv, 27 Oct).


## Deferred (28 Oct 2026)

hv, 28 Oct 2026, on utilz-vc's rating of the open work: P3, deferred. Not in 2.14.6, which carries 0125 alone. Target: the first Utilz release after devbin 0.1.16 (devbin 0243) is cut and vendored, so 2.14.7 at the earliest. Not started; ic's hold 18 waits for the vendoring.
